text:
Anya Patel: Heads-up — PR #21987 is blocked by a mac-only smoke failure (snapshot mismatch). Seen this in 2 separate runs, same diff for toolbar icon. Can someone take a quick look? Do we want a targeted rerun or just update the snapshot? :eyes:
Miguel Torres: I'll take a look now. Any repro steps or logs you can paste?
Anya Patel: paste log below — failing assertion and the image diff link: https://internal-ci/reports/21987/mac-smoke/shard7/diff.png
```
FAIL: RendererToolbarTest.ShouldShowIcon
Expected: snapshot/toolbar/toolbar_v2.png
Actual:   artifacts/21987/toolbar_v2.png
--- a/snapshot/toolbar/toolbar_v2.png
+++ b/artifacts/21987/toolbar_v2.png
@@ -1,1 +1,1 @@
-<binary diff: small alpha channel shift>
+<binary diff: small alpha channel shift>
```
Lin Zhao: This looks like the usual nondet icon render (antialiasing/alpha). My vote: targeted rerun first. If it flips, we skip updating snapshot. If it's consistent, update snapshot + add a tiny tolerance in the render test.
Sam Lee: Agree with Lin. Hold merge until we know. If rerun passes once and fails again, we should bisect or add guard. No approvals until we know cause.
Miguel Torres: Running a targeted rerun on shard7 now (`bk retry --job mac-smoke-shard7 --pr 21987`). Will post results.
ci-bot: Rerun started: buildkite/21987/mac-smoke-shard7 (attempt 2)
ci-bot: Rerun finished: buildkite/21987/mac-smoke-shard7 — PASS (flaky) :thumbsup:
Miguel Torres: Huh — first rerun passed. I'm kicking another retry to be sure.
ci-bot: Rerun started: buildkite/21987/mac-smoke-shard7 (attempt 3)
ci-bot: Rerun finished: buildkite/21987/mac-smoke-shard7 — FAIL (same diff) :sadparrot:
Anya Patel: OK that's flaky. Miguel — can you try to reproduce locally with `bazel test //tests:RendererToolbarTest --test_arg=--update-snapshots=false` and attach run env (mac OS build image + X display env)?
Miguel Torres: Will try; if local repro is flaky too I'll add a small retry wrapper for the test and file a follow-up to add tolerance to pixel comparison. If no local repro, we keep PR blocked and mark flaky.
Lin Zhao: If you're adding a retry wrapper, prefer a short-term test-only retry (3 attempts) and a ticket for proper fix. That'll let product merges continue without hiding a real regression.
Sam Lee: Ping @eng for eyes — if we want to unblock sooner we could temporarily exempt this PR from merge queue with a note, but i'd rather not. Please respond by EOD if you can review or approve once Miguel posts reproduction results. :clock3:
Anya Patel: Thanks everyone — Miguel, update here when you have local logs. I'll hold merge and add a quick comment on the PR explaining the flaky findings.
Miguel Torres: (posting later) Local run reproduced the failure twice. I'll open PR-21987.1 to add a retry wrapper + ticket link to JIRA INC-1234 and request a fast follow-up patch for pixel tolerance.
Sam Lee: Sounds good. Once that follow-up PR is up, ping me and I'll take a fast review.
Anya Patel: :thumbsup: Thanks all.
